name: Code & Circuits Society
summary: Weekly build nights, coding workshops and peer mentoring for anyone curious about software.
description: Code & Circuits is a student-run community for people who like to build things with software and hardware. We host weekly build nights, beginner-friendly workshops on web and mobile development, and a peer mentoring scheme that pairs first-years with experienced builders. Members also form teams for hackathons and coding competitions throughout the year.
membership: Open to all students. Attend any build night and add your name to the members list — no prior experience required.

name: Venture Lab Collective
summary: A community for student founders testing ideas, pitching and learning from operators.
description: Venture Lab Collective helps students move from idea to tested venture. We run customer-discovery sprints, pitch clinics and fireside chats with founders. Members get feedback on business models and support preparing for startup competitions.
membership: Apply with a short form at the start of each semester. Students without an idea yet are welcome.

name: Green Campus Initiative
summary: Student projects that reduce waste, save energy and make campus life more sustainable.
description: Green Campus Initiative runs practical sustainability projects: recycling drives, energy audits, tree planting and awareness campaigns. Members learn project management and data collection while making measurable improvements to campus life.
meetingInfo: Every other Wednesday, 16:00, Student Centre Room 3
membership: Join any project team by signing up at a general meeting.

name: Undergraduate Research Circle
summary: Connects students with research methods training, faculty projects and paper-reading groups.
description: The Undergraduate Research Circle helps students get started in research. We run methods workshops, a monthly paper-reading group and an annual student research showcase. We also share calls for research assistants and help members prepare applications.
meetingInfo: First Monday of the month, 18:00, Library Seminar Room
membership: Open to all. Sign up for the mailing list at any event.

name: Hillside Debate Union
summary: Competitive debate, public speaking practice and inter-university tournaments.
description: Hillside Debate Union trains students in argumentation, research and public speaking. We practise British Parliamentary format weekly and send teams to inter-university tournaments. New speakers receive structured coaching from experienced members.
membership: Attend two practice sessions to become a full member.

name: Women in STEM Network
summary: Mentorship, skills sessions and community for women studying science and technology.
description: Women in STEM Network builds a supportive community for women in science, technology, engineering and mathematics. We host mentorship circles with alumni, technical skill sessions and outreach to secondary schools. All students who support our mission are welcome.
membership: Complete the short interest form; mentorship circles open each semester.

name: Finance & Investment Club
summary: Learn markets, personal finance and analysis through case studies and a simulated portfolio.
description: The Finance & Investment Club teaches practical finance through weekly case studies, a simulated investment portfolio and sessions on personal finance. Members prepare for finance careers and case competitions.
membership: Open sign-up at the start of each semester.

name: Community Outreach Corps
summary: Volunteering with nearby schools and communities: tutoring, health drives and literacy.
description: Community Outreach Corps organises regular volunteering with nearby communities. Our programmes include after-school tutoring, reading clubs, health screening support and community clean-ups. Volunteers receive orientation before their first placement.
membership: Attend an orientation session, then choose a programme.

name: Open Design Studio
summary: Product design, illustration and UX critique sessions for designers and developers.
description: Open Design Studio is a space for visual and product design. We run UX critique sessions, illustration jams and collaborative projects with student organisations that need branding or interface design help.
membership: Drop in to any session. Bring a sketchbook or laptop.

name: Robotics & Automation Team
summary: Design, build and program robots for competitions and real-world automation problems.
description: The Robotics & Automation Team designs and builds robots for competitions and campus automation projects. Members learn mechanical design, embedded programming and control systems in small project teams.
membership: Recruitment opens at the start of each semester with a short hands-on challenge.

name: Mind & Body Wellness Collective
summary: Fitness sessions, mental health awareness and peer support for a balanced student life.
description: The Mind & Body Wellness Collective promotes physical and mental wellbeing. We run morning fitness sessions, stress-management workshops during exam periods and peer-support training in partnership with campus counselling.
membership: No sign-up needed — join any session.

name: Campus Football Club
summary: Recreational and competitive football for all skill levels.
description: Campus Football Club runs recreational games and competitive teams that play in inter-university leagues. Training is open to all skill levels, and we organise a friendly inter-year tournament every semester.
membership: Turn up to training. League team selection happens at the start of each season.

name: Pan-African Arts Society
summary: Celebrates African music, dance, film and literature through performances and workshops.
description: The Pan-African Arts Society celebrates the creative traditions of the continent. We host dance and drumming workshops, film screenings with discussions, poetry nights and an annual cultural showcase.
membership: Everyone is welcome. Performers can audition for the showcase each year.

name: Student Media House
summary: Student newspaper, podcast and video team covering campus life.
description: Student Media House publishes the student newspaper, produces a weekly podcast and creates short video features about campus life. Members learn writing, editing, audio and video production, and editorial leadership.
membership: Submit a short writing, audio or video sample to join a desk.

name: Global Health Society
summary: Explores public health challenges through talks, case competitions and community projects.
description: Global Health Society brings together students interested in public health, medicine and health systems. We host expert talks, run health case competitions and support community health projects with partner organisations.
meetingInfo: Every other Tuesday, 18:00, Library Seminar Room
membership: Sign up at any event to join the mailing list and project teams.

name: Career Readiness Network
summary: CV clinics, mock interviews and employer sessions to prepare for internships and jobs.
description: Career Readiness Network helps students prepare for internships and graduate roles. We run CV and cover letter clinics, mock interviews with volunteers from industry and sessions on navigating the job market.
membership: Open to all students — just register for any session.
